_comment: Client-public build values for the browser bundle.
These are inlined into JavaScript by definition (VITE_*), so nothing here
is secret: the publishable Supabase key and the site URL already ship to
every visitor in the built assets.
They live in the repository so a build always produces a working client.
The Cloudflare Pages project had no environment variables at all, so every
git-triggered build inlined an empty Supabase URL and the browser app
failed to start with 'supabaseUrl is required'.
Real environment variables still win: anything set in the build
environment or in .env / .env.production overrides these defaults.
